groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.text: Arthur feels that when starting a business, mistakes should be

options.t: seen as an opportunity to learn.
predicted and minimised.
avoided at all costs.

questions.text: Recent American studies found that confidence will

options.t: sometimes reduce people's chances of success.
be increased by reading self-help books.
ensure good results on business courses.

questions.text: The American studies recommended that new entrepreneurs

options.t: listen to their colleagues' advice.
get professional help when things go wrong.
remain concentrated on their aims.

questions.text: What does Arthur say about his own experience of marketing?

options.t: He relied on what he already knew.
He hired an expert to take care of it.
He realised its importance too late.

questions.text: What does Arthur think is an important quality shared by good leaders?

options.t: They are ambitious for their company.
They can deal with difficult people.
They earn the respect of their workforce.

questions.text: What does Arthur say about taking risks?

options.t: He advises being cautious.
He favours a long-term view.
He believes it is financially advantageous.

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A - E. Which TWO things does Arthur say people should focus on when developing their business idea?

options.t: making sure the idea is original
offering a better deal than competitors
being committed to it
paying attention to detail
fixing realistic prices

groups.instruction: Choose TWO letters, A - E. Which TWO things does Arthur say helped him get his business started?

options.t: family support
getting a loan from a bank
good business advice
a favourable economic climate
an effective approach to business
